newsitem.title: UK: Major says UK heading for tax cuts if he wins.
newsitem.headline: Major says UK heading for tax cuts if he wins.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major said on Monday that Britons could look forward to tax cuts if the ruling Conservatives win an unprecedented fifth election win in a row.
Major, interviewed by BBC Television, said: "We now find ourselves for the future in a wholly different position, because we now have not just stable, but very buoyant growth.

"Because we have a pattern of growth and expenditure that is below the growth in income, we are in a much better position to look forward to tax reductions or spending in the next parliament as we choose," he added.
The opposition Labour Party are overwhelming opinion poll favourites to win Thursday's election and end 18 years of Conservative rule.
